Definition: from G263; "amaranthine", i.e. (by implication) fadeless:--that fadeth not away.
BiblicalUsage: Once, in the promise to the elders: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away. The word is amaranthine, of the flower that does not fade, and the crown is made of it.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for unfading carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the crown, that the shepherds who feed the flock are promised a glory that does not wither.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
